title: Developer signup funnel attrition at email verification
what: email_verify stage drop rate (%), users dropped at email_verify, or overall completion (%)

reader_questions.question: Which funnel stage loses the most users, and how severe is the drop?
reader_questions.expected: email_verify loses 7,056 users (46.0% of users entering that stage).

reader_questions.question: Is the drop at email_verify based on a small sample?
reader_questions.expected: No, it is measured across 15,340 users entering email_verify (24,000 total funnel entrants).

reader_questions.question: What is the top drop reason at email_verify, and what is the overall funnel completion rate?
reader_questions.expected: Top reason is verification_email_delayed; overall landing-to-first_request completion is 23.5%.
